_comment: Santorini locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} intact. Never translate the ASCII {board}, the color names passed as {color}/{winner_color}/etc. (Navy/White/Grey), worker labels (N1, N2, W1, W2, G1, G2), the move token format [worker_id source dest build] / examples like [N1C1C2B2], board coordinates (A-E, 1-5), or level numbers.

_slots.{color}: The player's color/role name (Navy, White or Grey) - do not translate
_slots.{color_initial}: First letter of the player's color, used to build the move token (N, W or G) - do not translate
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII board - insert as-is, do not translate
_slots.{valid_moves}: Comma-separated list of valid move tokens - do not translate
_slots.{expected_color}: Color of the worker that was addressed - do not translate
_slots.{player_color}: The acting player's own color - do not translate
_slots.{source}: Source board coordinate, e.g. C2 - do not translate
_slots.{dest}: Destination board coordinate, e.g. C3 - do not translate
_slots.{build}: Build board coordinate, e.g. B2 - do not translate
_slots.{winner_color}: The winning player's color - do not translate
_slots.{loser_color}: The losing player's color - do not translate

player_prompt.intro:
You are playing {color} in a game of Santorini.

Game Rules:
1. Movement:
   - Workers can only move to adjacent squares (including diagonals)
   - Cannot move to squares occupied by other workers or domes
   - Can move up maximum one level, but can move down any number of levels

2. Building:
   - Must build in a square adjacent to where your worker moved to
   - Cannot build where any worker is standing
   - Cannot build on top of a dome (level 4)
   - Building adds one level (or creates a dome on level 3)

3. Win Conditions:
   - Win by moving a worker to level 3
   - Win if opponent has no valid moves

Make your move in the format [worker_id source dest build]
Example: [{color_initial}1C1C2B2] means move {color} worker 1 from C1 to C2 and build at B2
You can include additional text in your messages, but you must only mention the valid move pattern once.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Invalid move format. Expected format: [worker_id source dest build], e.g. [N1C1C2B2]

game_action.moved: Player {player_id} ({color}) moved worker {worker_num} from {source} to {dest} and built at {build}

outcome.win_level3: Player {winner_id} ({winner_color}) won by moving a worker to level 3!
outcome.no_moves: Player {loser_id} ({loser_color}) has no valid moves. Player {winner_id} ({winner_color}) wins!
